shots.probe: ({ wind: !!document.querySelector('.wind-canvas'), overlaysOnTop: (() => { const m = window.__map_full; const ids = m.getStyle().layers.map(l => l.id); return ids.indexOf('density-a') > ids.indexOf('base') || !ids.includes('base'); })() })

shots.name: basemaps/wind-india-dark
shots.js: (async () => { document.querySelector('.topbar-menu').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); [...document.querySelectorAll('.layers-pop .chip')].find(c => /Wind/.test(c.textContent)).click(); document.querySelector('.topbar-menu').click(); window.__map_full.jumpTo({ center: [75, 12], zoom: 3.3 }); })()
shots.probe: ({ wind: !!document.querySelector('.wind-canvas'), drawn: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('.wind-canvas'); if (!c) return 0; const d = c.getContext('2d').getImageData(0,0,c.width,c.height).data; let n = 0; for (let i = 3; i < d.length; i += 16) if (d[i] > 20) n++; return n; })() })
